description: The file defines locale-specific culture information for the Thai (Thailand) locale (th-TH) used by the Date.js library, including date/time formats, month/day names, and parsing patterns.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time components of the date to zero, effectively clearing the time part.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date's time to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.
